content.statement: The current returns policy v2 explicitly specifies a 30-day full-refund window for standard items, so the claimed current 30-day window is supported.
content.plan: Extracted the current policy value from policy_docs.returns_policy_v2, compared it with the stale base_judge_reference_days and base_retrieval v1 value, checked the 10-day-old standard order against both windows, and computed the numeric difference; a two-sample t-test was not applicable because no n, mean, or sd fields were provided.
